jobs.description:
Luxury Housekeeping Specialist/ Room Attendant (m/f/d) – 5-Star Swiss & LQA Standards (m/w/d) — Kulm Hotel St. Moritz (Kulm Hotel), St. Moritz (Engadin, Graubünden). Workload: 100%. Contract: Saisonstelle / Seasonal. Start: 2026-11-24.

People at 1800m above sea level are shaping the Luxury Mountain Travel. Our dynamic and international community offers our guests smart Luxury for an inimitable holiday experience. As a member of the Luxury Kulm Group you are part of the key to our success. Together, we make every stay deeply inspiring, unique and distinctive. And as such, we embrace our culture: understated luxury, inspiration, and a life experience. Together, we make it happen. This is your chance to be a member of our shaping culture: | This is you::
• Minimum 2–3 years of experience as a Room Attendant strictly in a 5-star luxury hotel (experience in top-tier Swiss or Alpine luxury properties is strongly preferred).

• Standard Knowledge: Solid understanding of LQA (Leading Quality Assurance) and/or Forbes Travel Guide standards in housekeeping.

• Mindset & Discretion: Absolute reliability, physical resilience, impeccable manners, and complete discretion when interacting with high-net-worth international guests.

• Language Skills: Functional conversational skills in English OR German (ability to follow instructions, safety standards, and guest requests); Italian is a strong advantage.

• Appearance: Flawless personal grooming and a professional demeanor at all times.
What We Offer
• Work in World-Class Properties: Be part of an award-winning housekeeping team in the heart of the Swiss Alps.

• Professional Environment: Structured workflows, clear quality benchmarks, and continuous training in luxury standards.

• Attractive Package: Competitive seasonal compensation, employee accommodation in the Engadin, subsidized meals in our staff restaurant, and exclusive group benefits.
Do you meet the 5-star experience requirements?We look forward to receiving your complete application (CV and employment references). | Benefits: At Kulm Group, our employees are the heart of our success. We offer attractive development opportunities, comfortable accommodations, affordable meals in the staff restaurant, and numerous perks.

jobs.description:
Kitchen Director/ Chef de Cuisine - new All-Day Dining Outlet (m/w/d) — Kulm Hotel St. Moritz (Kulm Hotel), St. Moritz (Engadin, Graubünden). Workload: 100%. Contract: Unbefristet / Permanent. Start: 2027-02-01.

People at 1800m above sea level are shaping the Luxury Mountain Travel. Our dynamic and international community offers our guests smart Luxury for an inimitable holiday experience. As a member of the Luxury Kulm Group you are part of the key to our success. Together, we make every stay deeply inspiring, unique and distinctive. And as such, we embrace our culture: understated luxury, inspiration, and a life experience. Together, we make it happen. This is your chance to be a member of our shaping culture: | Something new is taking shape. And you will write the first chapter.: In the winter of 2027/28, Kulm Hotel St. Moritz will open a new all-day dining restaurant: French in style (offering refined yet relaxed dining), generous in spirit, and built with the clear ambition to become a new culinary benchmark in the Engadin from day one. We aren't revealing all the details just yet—but for the person chosen to shape this kitchen, we are happy to lift the curtain just a bit. We are looking for a Kitchen Director who doesn't just accompany an opening, but leads it with vision, a strong hands-on mindset, and active leadership at the pass.What you will achieve with us:
• Strategic & Operational Setup: From the initial concept idea to the grand opening night and beyond—you will drive the project from A to Z.

• A Distinct Culinary Signature: You will develop a culinary profile that delights our discerning guests from their first morning coffee late into the evening.

• Team Building & Leadership: Together with us, you will assemble a high-performing brigade of around 20 chefs, leading them inspiringly and fostering their growth.

• Internal Hub: Working in close alignment with hotel management, Culinary Management, and the F&B team, you will actively shape operational workflows, supplier networks, and purchasing.

• Uncompromising Standards & Control: Quality, flawless HACCP procedures, food cost control, stock management, and sustainable waste reduction are your daily benchmark. | This is you::
• Proven Opening Expert: You have already managed a high-profile restaurant opening or significantly contributed to one in a senior role (e.g., as Executive Sous-Chef or Chef de Cuisine) – ideally within bistro-style or upscale café-restaurant operations.

• High-End Background: You bring solid experience from luxury hospitality and/or fine dining (comparable to a level of around 16 GaultMillau points).

• Passion for France: You are passionate about French cuisine—and you know how to interpret it in a modern, light, contemporary way, while remaining open to international influences.

• Leadership & Integrity ("Leader at the Pass"): You are actively involved in day-to-day kitchen operations. Clear communication, leading by example, and mutual respect define your management style. Teams naturally follow your lead.

• Language Skills: An international background is welcome. Business-fluent English and/or Italian are required; good knowledge of German is a strong advantage.
Why Kulm Hotel?
• Creative Autonomy: The rare opportunity to help shape a new culinary concept right from the very beginning.

• Tradition Meets Future: Winter tourism once began at Kulm Hotel St. Moritz—now write the next great chapter.

• Strong Environment: A highly professional, appreciative team and full backing from the executive management. | Benefits: At the Kulm Group, our employees are at the heart of our success. Alongside a forward-looking workplace in one of the world’s most beautiful destinations, we offer attractive career development opportunities, comfortable staff accommodation, excellent dining in our staff restaurant, and exclusive benefits. Curious? We look forward to receiving your compelling application, including your CV and a brief note on what excites you most about this entrepreneurial role. Naturally, all inquiries will be treated with strict confidentiality.

jobs.title: Executive Housekeeping Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Executive Housekeeping Manager (m/w/d) — Kulm Hotel St. Moritz (Grand Hotel Kronenhof), Pontresina (Engadin, Graubünden). Workload: 100%. Contract: Unbefristet / Permanent. Start: 2026-11-01.

Where historic charm meets modern luxury – Grand Hotel Kronenhof in Pontresina is one of the most renowned 5-star superior hotels in Switzerland. Overlooking the fascinating Engadin mountain scenery, we celebrate hospitality at the highest level. To perfectly present this magical place for our guests, we are looking for a personality who has cleanliness, elegance and leadership in their blood. | This is what you move with us: As Executive Housekeeper, you are the driving force behind the impeccable appearance of our hotel. You report directly to the Rooms Division Manager and lead an international team of approximately 24 employees.

• Quality assurance at 5-star level: You ensure impeccable cleanliness and living quality in all guest rooms and public areas – always in line with the demanding standards of Swiss Deluxe Hotels, Forbes and Leading Quality Assurance (LQA). You are also responsible for our staff accommodation.

• Inspiring leadership: You are a coach and role model for your team. You are responsible for staff scheduling, conduct training sessions (equipment and cleaning procedures), carry out performance reviews and are actively involved in the recruitment process of new talents.

• Efficient management & logistics: You manage inventory, oversee the purchasing of hotel linen and uniforms, and coordinate the smooth laundry process in close cooperation with our sister hotel, Kulm.

• Interface professional: You are in daily contact with the Executive Management, Engineering, Floristry and Front Office to ensure smooth housekeeping operations. | This is you:
